name: io.github.jamesdfinance-dev/lazaretto
description: Verify a skill, tool, or package for malicious behavior before an agent installs it: known-bad match plus deterministic behavioral analysis, over the Lazaretto API.

environmentVariables.name: LAZARETTO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional key with prepaid scan credits (buy at https://lazaretto.dev/#pricing). Enables paid full scans.

environmentVariables.name: LAZARETTO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Default https://lazaretto.dev.
